answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by pricing identity in verified time: an account gains weight only after its work is checked and countersigned by established peers, epoch after epoch. Like quartz, trust here is a crystal that grows slowly under pressure - it cannot be poured into shape overnight. A beacon account that vouches carelessly burns its own standing, so endorsements stay honest; and no nectar of rewards flows to fresh keys that have proven nothing.
